name: Mandelbrot
description: Mandelbrot set zooming in over time (generator). Computed in f32: the picture turns blocky after about 60 s at the default zoom speed (FFmpeg uses double).

params.name: start_x
params.description: Real part of the zoom center

params.name: start_y
params.description: Imaginary part of the zoom center

params.name: start_scale
params.description: View height in the complex plane at time 0

params.name: end_scale
params.description: View height in the complex plane at `end_time`

params.name: end_time
params.description: Seconds to go from `start_scale` to `end_scale` (exponentially; goes on past it)

params.name: inner_mode
params.description: Points inside the set: 0 black, 1 white, 2 colored by the last z

params.name: outer_mode
params.description: Points outside: 0 iteration count, 1 smooth iteration count, 2 white, 3 colored by the escaping z

params.name: opacity
params.description: Blend over the input picture: 1 = only the generated picture, 0 = the input unchanged
